spans.text: Based on previous findings it was hypothesized that individuals with   high   resting state vmHRV would exhibit differentiated activation of prefrontal brain regions and the amygdala according to the ER direction and that   low   resting state vmHRV would be related to less involvement of PFC structures and less modulation of the activation of the amygdala.
